## Design

### 2026-11-02: Did the PCB today! My meshtastic node is based around NRF52840 Pro Micro (nice!nano) and has HT-RA62 LoRa module that's going to be used for communication. I choose these things because I'm following

**2.73h**

Did the PCB today! My meshtastic node is based around NRF52840 Pro Micro (nice!nano) and has HT-RA62 LoRa module that's going to be used for communication. I choose these things because I'm following a tutorial even though I wanted to make this fully custom made by me. I just don't have the skills yet, so I'd rather not jump into the deep waters. I also added some buttons that I've got on hand. One is for reset and the other one is just for special functions, like SOS and so on. I really like how small it is tbh! Tommorow I think I'm going to start designing the enclosure for the node I'm going to have with myself and then design one for the repeater. Also here's how the PCB looks for now!

### 2026-11-03: Dang, I did a LOT today.

**3.58h**

Dang, I did a LOT today.

Completely redid the PCB because I changed the modules I'm using. I switched to HT-RA62 for LoRa and added ATGM336H for GPS (for RTC and localization). I also added a mosfet, so I'll be able to turn off the GPS module to save power + there are two more - one for a buzzer and one for a vibration motor. I think the schematic is wired correctly (at least I hope so ._. ) and tomorrow I'll start making traces. I thought I would be done with the PCB by now, but it looks like this is harder that I though xD Also here's how the PCB looks! I think it's cool!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/vhPuIXXulHs6LeuYMclarNIsOTRiD2p5/e727cc0de44ccb02a3f553e78da8eec4aa207f6517f98939ae18e7e2ca3b8623.png)
